overview.text: Soil_1_12 is a biosynthetic gene cluster detected only by GECCO and has no assigned compound class.
It spans 12 kb on contig_1 and contains 13 genes.

genes.text: The locus holds two regulatory genes, three tailoring enzymes and two resistance genes according to BGC-XPLORER annotation.
No detection tool identifies a core biosynthetic gene within the agreed span of this locus.
ARTS finds one hit to a known resistance model.

similar.text: This locus has not been compared with MIBiG because antiSMASH did not detect it.

hypothesis.text: The gene products include enzymes of the arginine deiminase pathway such as ornithine carbamoyltransferase and arginine deiminase, together with a phosphoketolase and several nucleotide-binding proteins, suggesting this cluster may be involved in primary metabolic processes such as arginine catabolism and energy production rather than specialised metabolite biosynthesis.

facts.sentence: Soil_1_12 is a biosynthetic gene cluster, found by GECCO only; no compound class is assigned to it.
It spans 12 kb on contig_1 (1,156,933–1,169,058) and contains 13 genes.
By the annotation categories of BGC-XPLORER, it holds 2 regulatory, 3 tailoring-enzyme and 2 resistance genes.
No detection tool names a core biosynthetic gene inside the agreed span of this locus.

Gene products in the locus, in genome order: CJLEIP_00984 ornithine carbamoyltransferase; CJLEIP_00985 Arginine deiminase; CJLEIP_00986 hypothetical protein; CJLEIP_00987 NUDIX hydrolase; CJLEIP_00988 LLM class F420-dependent oxidoreductase; CJLEIP_00989 DUF6099 domain-containing protein; CJLEIP_00990 Nucleotide pyrophosphohydrolase; CJLEIP_00991 ATP-binding protein; CJLEIP_00992 Cell division protein SepF; CJLEIP_00993 Plasmid stabilization protein; CJLEIP_00994 putative phosphoketolase; CJLEIP_00995 Regulatory protein; CJLEIP_00996 Integral membrane protein.
ARTS finds 1 hit to known resistance models.
This locus has not been compared with MIBiG: the comparison is made by antiSMASH, which did not detect it.
